findings.failure_scenario: swissknifeman install --profile minimal --bin-dir DIR --force (standard and full take the same planner step) dry-runs 'would link: DIR/plan.py -> packages/planner/scripts/plan.py' because planner has provides.cli [scripts/plan.py] and no provides.install. The real run sees git mode 100644, prints 'ATTENTION: .../scripts/plan.py is not executable - not linked', leaves DIR/plan.py absent, records status skipped and links [], keeps failed empty, and exits 0. The Done line still names planner. hub-p12#install requires the symlink for a module with provides.cli and without provides.install. The umbrella runs this file as python3 scripts/plan.py, so the +x gate drops the plans command of the minimal profile. Fixture CLIs in scripts/test-umbrella.py are chmod 0755, and the real-profile test only dry-runs, so V1 and V2 stay green.
findings.reproduction: Temp HOME and SKM_HOME, load_units(), execute_plan on planner. Dry-run status planned with links [plan.py]. Real run printed the ATTENTION line, failed=[], step status skipped, links=[], and the bin dir contained only the swissknifeman symlink.

triage_reproduction.cmd: H=$(mktemp -d); HOME=$H SKM_HOME=$H/skm bin/swissknifeman install --units planner --force --bin-dir $H/bin; ls $H/bin; git ls-files -s packages/planner/scripts/plan.py
triage_reproduction.observed: Printed 'ATTENTION: .../packages/planner/scripts/plan.py is not executable - not linked' and exited 0. The Done line still lists planner. $H/bin held only aicore and swissknifeman, with no plan.py. git mode of plan.py is 100644.

findings.failure_scenario: ./install.sh --force on a TTY, when the topology file is absent ($SKM_HOME/state/maind/topology.json, or with SKM_HOME unset $HOME/.local/state/swissknifeman/maind/topology.json and $HOME/.swissknifeman/topology.json), reaches the topology prompt. The condition is a missing file and a TTY. --force is not in the condition, so read -p blocks on 'Configure local environment map (skiller topology init)? [y/N]'. hub-p12#install says a provides.install command asks nothing when --force is set or when stdin is not a TTY. The no-TTY path is guarded and returns. The --force path on a TTY still waits. Harness, maind, and analyst only prompt for a foreign symlink, and that prompt is skipped when --force is set.

triage_reproduction.cmd: H=$(mktemp -d); cd packages/skiller; HOME=$H SKM_HOME=$H/skm timeout 10 script -qec "bash install.sh --force --bin-dir $H/bin" /dev/null </dev/null
triage_reproduction.observed: Printed 'Installed: .../bin/skiller' and then 'Configure local environment map (skiller topology init)? [y/N]'. It then blocked until the timeout killed it. --force did not skip the prompt. Exit 1 is from the timeout, not from the script.

findings.failure_scenario: On a TTY, with a foreign file already at $BIN/harness (the same pattern exists in skiller, maind, and analyst install.sh), swissknifeman install --profile standard --json without --force runs the module installer with capture_output=True. That redirects stdout and stderr and leaves stdin on the terminal. The installer sees a TTY and read -p writes the replace prompt into the captured stderr. The process waits on stdin with no visible prompt until a line arrives.

triage_reproduction.cmd: H=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $H/bin; echo x >$H/other; ln -s $H/other $H/bin/harness; (sleep 8) | HOME=$H SKM_HOME=$H/skm timeout 6 script -qec "bin/swissknifeman install --units harness --json --bin-dir $H/bin" /dev/null
triage_reproduction.observed: With a pty on stdin and a foreign symlink at the harness link, the command printed nothing and blocked until the 6s timeout. Without input it never finished. The prompt went into the captured output.

findings.failure_scenario: swissknifeman install --units , (also --units '' and --units=) parses units to an empty list. select_units treats that empty list as an absent --units and selects the default profile standard: aicore, skiller, planner, harness, brain, orch, including the skiller and harness installers. An explicit empty unit list therefore installs the default profile.
findings.reproduction: _install_args(['--units', ',']) returned units []. select_units(units, profiles, None, []) returned label standard and ids [aicore, skiller, planner, harness, brain, orch].

triage_reproduction.observed: Exited 0 and printed a dry-run plan for the default profile: aicore, skiller (would run install.sh), planner, harness and the rest. An explicit empty unit list selected the default profile.

findings.failure_scenario: swissknifeman install --profile minimal --bin-dir DIR --force (standard and full take the same planner step) creates DIR/plan.py as a symlink to packages/planner/scripts/plan.py. That file is git mode 100644 and mode 0664 on disk, so it has no execute bit. Executing DIR/plan.py returns permission denied (exit 126): the kernel requires the execute bit on the symlink target and never reads the shebang. The install exits 0 and records the planner step as status ok with links [plan.py]. The warning says the file is run through the interpreter; the symlink is invoked directly and _command is not on this path.
findings.reproduction: git ls-files -s -- packages/planner/scripts/plan.py shows 100644; os.access on that path is false (mode 0664). scripts/umbrella.py execute_plan calls _link, which only symlink_to's the target.

triage_reproduction.cmd: H=$(mktemp -d); HOME=$H SKM_HOME=$H/skm bin/swissknifeman install --profile minimal --bin-dir $H/bin --force; $H/bin/plan.py --help
triage_reproduction.observed: Установка завершилась с кодом 0 и создала симлинк bin/plan.py на packages/planner/scripts/plan.py. Этот файл имеет режим 100644 в git и 0664 на диске. Запуск симлинка дал 'Permission denied', код 126.
